title: Logos : tout sur l'initiale
intro: Des logos qui frappent, construits sur la première lettre du nom. Deux essais par idée, en GPT Image 2.5 (texte lisible).

jobs.label: B1-le-a-sling · essai 1
jobs.prompt: Bold, iconic logo for ANNABELLE CLUB, a cheeky fictional 1974 surf club from Les Sables-d'Olonne. Martin Parr humour, pop 1970s, confident and a little provocative. Palette: mandarine #F26A2E, pool blue #4FB3D9, lemon #F5E663, pistachio #B5D99C, ink #1E2A44 on cream #FBF7EF. Flat vector-quality mark centered on a plain cream background, big margins, perfect spelling, no mockup, no extra words. The mark must be striking and memorable, readable at 2 cm. IDEA: the capital letter A IS the product. The two diagonal legs of a huge geometric A are the two flat webbing straps of a surfboard sling meeting at the apex like on a shoulder, and the crossbar is a longboard passing horizontally through a small mandarine canvas panel. Below, the wordmark ANNABELLE CLUB in heavy rounded 1970s capitals, and 'SABLES D'OLONNE 1974' tiny.

jobs.group: Annabelle & la Lune · lune dans le a
jobs.label: D1-lune-dans-le-a · essai 1
jobs.prompt: Bold, iconic logo for ANNABELLE & LA LUNE, a tender surreal surf brand from Les Sables-d'Olonne. Luigi Ghirri and Wes Anderson: pastel, symmetrical, deadpan, poetic, with one strange detail. Palette: mint #BFE3D6, mustard #D9A431, powder blue #BBD7EE, pale pink #F3D3DC, ink #1E2A44 on cream #FBF7EF. Flat vector-quality mark centered on a plain cream background, big margins, perfect spelling, no mockup, no extra words. The mark must be striking and memorable, readable at 2 cm. IDEA: a tall elegant serif capital A in ink whose triangular counter (the hole inside the A) holds a perfect pale full moon, as if the moon were trapped inside the letter; a thin mustard horizon line crosses at the crossbar. Below, 'ANNABELLE & LA LUNE' in spaced delicate capitals.
